ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: Image description: The diagram shows two circles with centers labeled (2,4) and (14,9), radii labeled 4 and 9, and a common external tangent line with positive slope touching both circles. The two circle centers are on the same side of this tangent line, below the line. Reasoning: Let the tangent be y = mx + b, so in standard form it is mx - y + b = 0. Since the centers are on the same side of the external tangent, use signed distances with the same sign: (2m - 4 + b)/sqrt(m^2 + 1) = 4 and (14m - 9 + b)/sqrt(m^2 + 1) = 9. Subtracting the first equation from the second gives 12m - 5 = 5sqrt(m^2 + 1). Squaring: (12m - 5)^2 = 25(m^2 + 1), so 144m^2 - 120m + 25 = 25m^2 + 25, hence 119m^2 - 120m = 0. With m > 0, m = 120/119. Then sqrt(m^2 + 1) = sqrt((120/119)^2 + 1) = 169/119. Substitute into 2m - 4 + b = 4sqrt(m^2 + 1): b = 4(169/119) - 2(120/119) + 4 = (676 - 240 + 476)/119 = 912/119.

raw_record.question_text: Circles with centers $(2,4)$ and $(14,9)$ have radii 4 and 9, respectively. The equation of a common external tangent to the circles can be written in the form $y = mx + b$ with $m > 0$. What is $b$?

method.method_draft: Use direct point-to-line distance equations. Read the centers and radii as C1=(2,4), r1=4 and C2=(14,9), r2=9, and let the tangent be y=mx+b, i.e. mx-y+b=0. From the diagram/positive-slope condition, take the two centers to be on the same side of the external tangent, so the signed distances have the same sign: (2m-4+b)/sqrt(m^2+1)=4 and (14m-9+b)/sqrt(m^2+1)=9. Subtract these equations to eliminate b, giving 12m-5=5sqrt(m^2+1). Square and solve with m>0 to get m=120/119. Substitute back, for example into 2m-4+b=4sqrt(m^2+1), to obtain b=912/119.

method.method_draft: Use the external center of similitude of the two circles. Read C1=(2,4), r1=4 and C2=(14,9), r2=9. For common external tangents, their intersection is the external homothety center H on the line through the centers, dividing externally in the ratio 4:9. Compute H=(9C1-4C2)/(9-4)=(-38/5,0). Therefore the desired tangent line passes through H, so y=m(x+38/5), meaning b=38m/5. Now impose tangency to the smaller circle: the distance from (2,4) to the line y=mx+38m/5 equals 4. This gives |2m-4+38m/5|/sqrt(m^2+1)=4. Use the positive-slope upper tangent branch shown in the diagram, square and solve to get m=120/119. Then b=(38/5)(120/119)=912/119.
method.CoT_raw: 图像中有两个圆：小圆标注圆心 (2,4)、半径 4，大圆标注圆心 (14,9)、半径 9；所画公共外切线斜率为正，并且是在两个圆上侧附近相切的那条切线。按照指定方法，设 C1=(2,4), r1=4，C2=(14,9), r2=9。公共外切线交于两圆的外位似中心 H，它在两圆心连线上并按半径比 4:9 外分，所以 H=(9C1-4C2)/(9-4)=((18,36)-(56,36))/5=(-38/5,0)。因此该切线经过 H，若写成 y=mx+b，则 y=m(x+38/5)，所以 b=38m/5。再用小圆的切线条件：直线为 mx-y+38m/5=0，圆心 (2,4) 到此直线的距离等于半径 4，即 |2m-4+38m/5|/sqrt(m^2+1)=4。整理为 |48m/5-4|/sqrt(m^2+1)=4。平方得 (48m/5-4)^2=16(m^2+1)，化简得到 m=0 或 m=120/119。根据图中所需的是斜率为正的上方公共外切线，取 m=120/119。于是 b=(38/5)(120/119)=912/119。
